title: How to Get Free Gym Trials in NZ — Every Major Chain's Trial Policy
meta_desc: Free gym trial passes in NZ, compare trial policies at major gym chains
intro: Before committing to a gym membership, trying before you buy is essential. Most major NZ gym chains offer free trial passes, allowing you to test their facilities and services. With prices ranging from $15 to $40 per week, it's crucial to find the best fit for your budget and fitness goals.

sections.heading: Gym Trial Pass Availability
sections.body: Major gym chains like Anytime Fitness, Jetts, and Les Mills offer free trial passes to prospective members. These trials typically last between 3 to 7 days, giving you a taste of their group fitness classes, equipment, and facilities.

sections.heading: Trial Pass Conditions
list: Requires a photo ID and proof of address
Limited to one trial per person
Must be used within a specified time frame

sections.heading: Contract Terms and Prices
sections.body: After using a free trial pass, you may be inclined to sign up for a membership. Be aware of the contract terms, which can range from 3 to 12 months. Prices vary depending on the gym chain and membership type, with some gyms offering discounts for long-term commitments or student memberships.

sections.heading: Getting the Best Value
sections.body: To make the most of your gym trial pass, research the gym chain's prices, contract terms, and facilities. Compare prices and services across different chains to find the best fit for your budget and fitness goals.

sections.heading: Find Your Nearest Gym
sections.body: With over 100 locations across NZ, you're likely to find a gym near you. Check out our gym guides for more information on specific chains, such as Anytime Fitness or Jetts.

cta.text: View Anytime Fitness prices and contracts

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.body: Free gym trial passes are an excellent way to experience different gyms and find the one that suits you best. By comparing trial policies, prices, and contract terms, you'll be well-equipped to make an informed decision about your gym membership.
